تستضعفوا (form X)
# تَسْتَضْعِفُوا (tastaḍʕifū) /tas.tadˤ.ʕi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
# تُسْتَضْعَفُوا (tustaḍʕafū) /tus.tadˤ.ʕa.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
